## Wave 3 Summary

The framework, between S99 and S102, independently re-derived a **Casimir-graded exponential mass function** `m_g ∝ exp(−k·C₂(p,q))` with a zero-free-parameter widening ratio `W_Casimir = 9/5 = 1.800` (S100a W2 / S101 `S101-W2-BLOCKTRACE-WIDENING`), in a different namespace, while Paasch's own ~70-year exponential-mass program (φ_paasch, the N(j)=7n integer scheme, the golden-ratio factor fN=√5−1, the α=(1/n3²)(f/2)^{1/4} formula) sits ~95% UNCOMPUTED inside the project. This wave **connects the two namespaces and harvests the bridges**. It translates the survey's five untraveled bridges (UB1–UB5) and the three highest-leverage next steps into one solo + four compute gates:

- **INV3-W3-1 (solo)** — the cheapest, most adversarial: machine-ε Sage QQ on the survey's own found coincidence `S₀ =? φ_paasch^{fN}` for both S₀ candidate values. Plan-freeze Sage pre-flight (this document) already shows it is a 4-sig-fig near-miss, NOT a machine-ε identity; the gate is structured to **kill it cleanly** while extracting the residual's structure (UB4 · A2).
- **INV3-W3-2 (compute)** — literature retrieval: do the W₃ minimal-model M(6,5) (c=4/5, Z₃-Potts) kink mass ratios (Reshetikhin–Smirnov) contain φ_paasch or fN within 2%? The "is φ_paasch a universality-class number?" test (UB2 · C2 · A3 · Coldea/E8).
- **INV3-W3-3 (compute)** — chain-level α-dim with n3=dim(3,0)=10 substituted throughout (Sage), + two-α reconciliation (is the IR 1/137 what α_GUT=1/10.8 runs to through KK thresholds?) (UB3 · C3 · A1).
- **INV3-W3-4 (compute)** — Casimir-graded N(j)=7n test on the L12 fold cache: do Paasch's integers {7,35,42,98,150} emerge from SU(3) Casimir/dimension mode-counting? Ties Paasch's absolute-m_p machinery to the framework's M_KK gap (UB1 · G1+G2).
- **INV3-W3-5 (compute)** — Koide Q=2/3 from the Casimir-envelope √m vector exp(−k·C₂/2) over 3 triality-distinct sectors + Z₃ wall geometry: does the 45° Foot angle fall out of the Z₃ junction symmetry? (UB5 · A3).

**Domain classification per `phononic-framing.md`**: the entire wave is **PARTICLE** (representation-theoretic content of D_K) on a **GEOMETRIC** substrate (the Casimir ladder / Peter-Weyl mode geometry). The mass IS the Higgs-overlap of a Peter-Weyl mode in the Jensen metric — it is not "acquired in a Higgs container." Every gate's `substrate_framing` field flows D_K eigenvalues → spectral/Casimir moments → mass observable, never the reverse.

**Honest-count discipline (mass phenomenology)**: numerical coincidences are cheap in this domain (the whole Paasch tradition is haunted by them). Every gate below pre-registers an explicit KILL criterion so it can FAIL cleanly. A FAIL is a result — it closes a corridor in the bridge map. Per the plan-freeze Sage pre-flight (recorded in each gate's substitution chain), the EXPECTED outcomes are: W3-1 FAIL/INFO (coincidence, not identity); W3-2 unknown (genuine literature lookup); W3-3 (i) PASS-structural / (ii) open; W3-4 INFO-partial (35,42 are SU(3) dims; 7,98,150 are not); W3-5 the central open test.

## Wave 3 Decision Point Prerequisites

All five gates are **independent of each other** — none consumes another W3 gate's verdict, so the wave dispatches as one batch (1 solo orchestrator-inline + 4 compute, ≤8 concurrent). No intra-wave prerequisite chain.

- **INV3-W3-1** (solo): no upstream verdict prereq. Inputs are canonical/published values (φ_paasch from `canonical_constants.py`; S₀ values from S100a/S101 verdict files, cross-track read-only). Runs orchestrator-inline at `/rclab-coordinate` time.
- **INV3-W3-2** (compute): no framework-verdict prereq; its decisive input is **external literature** (Reshetikhin–Smirnov W₃ kink masses). If the literature retrieval returns nothing usable (no published W₃ M(6,5) kink mass-ratio table accessible via paper-search/web), the gate honestly closes INFO `value='lit-unavailable'` per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` — NOT a physics FAIL.
- **INV3-W3-3** (compute): no upstream W3 verdict prereq. Anchors: α_GUT=1/10.8 (open-channel Q18a; the snapshot constant `alpha_GUT=1/40` in `s42_constants_snapshot_verdict.txt` is a Step-2b approximation — the gate pins the survey/Q18a value 1/10.8 and flags both readings). M_KK from `canonical_constants.py`.
- **INV3-W3-4** (compute): consumes the **L12 fold cache** `computations/session-84/s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz` (confirmed present at plan-freeze; structure `sector_evals[(p,q)] = {dim:int, level:int, abs_evals:ndarray}`, 90 sectors). Input SHA `<computed-at-runtime>`.
- **INV3-W3-5** (compute): consumes the same L12 fold cache (for the Casimir-envelope √m vector at the three triality-distinct sectors (1,0)/(1,1)/(3,0)) + the S99 sector assignment. Input SHA `<computed-at-runtime>`.

If the L12 cache is absent at dispatch (it is present at plan-freeze), W3-4 and W3-5 close PRE-REG-INC per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`.

The composition phi^fN is within 0.025% of S0 but is NOT the algebraic source — typical of mass-phenomenology near-coincidences. ## Wave 3 → (downstream) Decision Point

Wave 3 is the terminal compute wave of the mass-quantization cluster; its outputs feed **INV3-W4-1** (the M_KK-derivability adjudication workshop, neutral planner) and the investigation-close session-promotion lift, NOT a further W3 gate. Branching by verdict:

- **INV3-W3-1**:
  - PASS (machine-ε identity — UNLIKELY per pre-flight) → escalate: the WHY-derivation becomes a high-priority session-promotion carry-forward (does τ_fold/T_acoustic carry a golden-ratio structure?); supplies a candidate home for the 4.7% widening residual (A2).
  - INFO (dead-band proximity — EXPECTED for 1.694153) → record the proximity; the "S₀=φ^fN identity" reading is killed; no widening-residual claim survives without a derivation.
  - FAIL (>1e-3 — EXPECTED for 95/56) → UB4 bridge removed from the map; clean negative.
- **INV3-W3-2**: PASS → φ_paasch promoted to universality-class number; feeds A3/C2 closure + the Coldea/E8 connection into session-promotion. FAIL → φ_paasch stays bare-spectrum-only. INFO (`lit-unavailable`) → carry-forward with explicit Reshetikhin-Smirnov literature target.
- **INV3-W3-3**: PASS(i) → A1 promoted to chain-level SU(3) identity (the sole-surviving Paasch-NCG bridge strengthened); feeds the φ_paasch/n3 register-tag hygiene (HY8). PASS(ii) → two-α unification (C3) into session-promotion. INFO(ii) → C3 directionally-supported, quantitatively open → RG-threshold-detail carry-forward.
- **INV3-W3-4**: PASS/INFO → **feeds INV3-W4-1 directly as adjudication candidate (c)** ("does N(j)=7n fix m_p hence M_KK without a hidden external scale?"). The verdict here is the single compute the M_KK-derivability workshop names as decisive. FAIL → candidate (c) is closed; the workshop adjudicates on (a)/(b) alone.
- **INV3-W3-5**: PASS → Koide substrate origin + A3 45° derivation into session-promotion (a new fermion-mass-frontier result). INFO → Koide reachable-not-derived → carry-forward the Z3-forcing question. FAIL → UB5 closed.

All session-promotion lifts route through `/rclab-investigate --investigation 3` close → housekeeping ledger §B (per `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` track-local boundary: an investigation result enters the knowledge index only when re-computed under a `session-{N}` gate). The Non-gate hygiene items HY8/HY9/HY11 (φ_paasch register tag; LNH-scaffolding exclusion note; OCR-garbled-formula re-pin) are NOT investigation edits — they are collected in the seed's §"Non-gate items" for session-promotion.
